note: Budgets checked by scripts/v4/verify-budgets.mjs. Sizes are gzip bytes and fail on more than size.tolerance growth. Runtime budgets are medians of repeated runs in Chromium at 4x CPU: observers and listeners created may not grow at all, observe() calls may not exceed budget x callTolerance, DOM mutation records budget x writeTolerance, and times max(budget x timeTolerance, budget + timeFloorMs); times are enforced only on the calibration platform. Budgets start at the values measured when they were introduced (4.2.0's engine) and are lowered as the 4.3 performance work lands; raise one only with a recorded reason.

changes.policy: Times are the Chromium 4x medians of three runs plus 10% headroom (the file's time tolerance still applies on top). Observer and listener counts, observe() calls and DOM mutation records are the measured medians exactly; their own tolerances (none for counts, callTolerance, writeTolerance) are the headroom.
changes.reasonForRaises: Times: a single group's earlier measurement against the merged build's median of three at load 4-7, within noise of 4.2.0 in a paired run (mount-200 first viewport 216 ms for 4.2.0 and 229 ms for 4.3.0; React 38-block commits 160 and 78 ms for 4.2.0). Counts: the React lanes gain the lifecycle hub's MutationObserver and its observe() calls (2 per document), which the react branch did not have. late-font nodeWrites 97885 -> 100720 and hidden intersectionObserve: C7 recomposes after a late font where 4.2.0 did not (WebKit left 59 of 195 paragraphs stale), and C8 observes revealed offscreen text until it comes near.
